nsw-sydney: Greater Sydney BEYOND the already-covered Sydney destination (its centre -33.8688,151.2093, ~40 km span, 77 existing spots which you must NOT re-judge or list): the Hawkesbury and Hills (Windsor, Wisemans Ferry, Ku-ring-gai Chase), the northern fringe (Palm Beach is covered; look at Broken Bay, Pittwater, Brooklyn, Cowan), south (Royal National Park fringe, Campbelltown, Camden, Wollondilly, Picton, Wollongong border), west (Penrith, Nepean, Parramatta outskirts, Richmond, Sydney International Regatta Centre, Wetherill Park). Only places a visitor would go to beyond ~25 km of the CBD or not already in the existing list.
nsw-blue-mountains-central-west: The Central West and Blue Mountains surroundings BEYOND the already-covered Blue Mountains and Warrumbungle destinations and Hill End (existing spots listed in existing-spots.json: do NOT re-judge them): Lithgow and the Capertee Valley, Mudgee wine region, Bathurst (Mount Panorama), Orange (food and wine, Mount Canobolas), Cowra (Japanese Garden), Parkes (the Dish), Dubbo (Taronga Western Plains Zoo), Wellington Caves, Jenolan Caves (if not in the Blue Mountains list), Kanangra-Boyd, Oberon, Forbes, Condobolin, Cobar is Outback (exclude). Also the Warrumbungle area beyond the national park.
nsw-central-coast-hunter: NSW Central Coast (Gosford, Terrigal, Brisbane Water National Park, Ettalong, Bouddi, Wyong, Lake Macquarie), Newcastle (Nobbys, Bogey Hole, Merewether, Fort Scratchley), Hunter Valley (Pokolbin wineries, Cessnock, Hunter Valley Gardens), Port Stephens (Anna Bay, Stockton Dunes, dolphin watching, Tomaree), Barrington Tops, Maitland, Morpeth, Dungog, Myall Lakes northern boundary is Mid North Coast.
nsw-mid-north-coast: NSW Mid North Coast: Forster-Tuncurry, Myall Lakes, Port Macquarie (Koala Hospital, Tacking Point, beaches), Kempsey, Crescent Head, Nambucca Heads, Bellingen, Dorrigo National Park (Skywalk), Coffs Harbour (Big Banana, Muttonbird Island, Solitary Islands), Sawtell, Woolgoolga, Hat Head, Macleay Valley, Taree, Gloucester.
nsw-northern-rivers: NSW Northern Rivers: Byron Bay (Cape Byron Lighthouse, beaches), Ballina, Lennox Head, Lismore, Nimbin, Bangalow, Murwillumbah, Mount Warning/Wollumbin, Tweed Heads, Yamba, Iluka, Brunswick Heads, Mullumbimby, Minyon Falls, Nightcap National Park, Wooli. Existing standalone spots there (border-ranges-national-park, yuraygir-national-park, grafton) are in existing-spots.json: re-judge them on the same bar.
nsw-new-england-north-west: NSW New England and North West: Armidale, Uralla, Walcha, Tamworth (Big Golden Guitar), Glen Innes (Australian Standing Stones), Tenterfield, Inverell, Oxley Wild Rivers, Cathedral Rock, Gibraltar Range, Washpool, Werrikimbe, Moree (artesian baths), Narrabri (Australia Telescope), Gunnedah, Mount Kaputar, Bingara, Lightning Ridge belongs to Outback (exclude).
nsw-south-coast: NSW South Coast: Illawarra (Wollongong, Kiama blowhole, Minnamurra Rainforest, Jamberoo, Nan Tien Temple, Sea Cliff Bridge, Stanwell Tops), Shoalhaven (Jervis Bay, Hyams Beach, Booderee is ACT-Commonwealth but in Jervis Bay, Nowra, Berry, Kangaroo Valley), Ulladulla, Batemans Bay, Mollymook, Narooma (Montague Island), Bermagui, Tathra, Merimbula, Eden (whale watching), Ben Boyd NP, Murramarang. Dharawal and Heathcote national parks are existing standalone spots in the Sydney region (not here).
nsw-southern-highlands-snowy: NSW Southern Highlands and Snowy Mountains: Bowral, Berrima, Moss Vale, Fitzroy Falls, Morton National Park, Goulburn (Big Merino), Yass, Queanbeyan border (exclude ACT places), Cooma, Jindabyne, Thredbo, Perisher, Charlotte Pass, Mount Kosciuszko, Kosciuszko National Park, Yarrangobilly Caves, Snowy Hydro, Adaminaby, Tumut, Khancoban, Bombala.
nsw-riverina-murray: NSW Riverina and Murray: Wagga Wagga, Griffith, Leeton, Narrandera, Albury (Hume Weir), Holbrook (Submarine Museum), Corowa, Deniliquin, Hay (Hay Plain), Balranald, Wentworth (Junction of Darling and Murray), Gundagai (Dog on the Tuckerbox), Tumbarumba, Murray River national parks, Barmah (Victorian side exclude), Cootamundra.
nsw-outback-far-west: NSW Outback and Far West: Broken Hill (Pro Hart, Line of Lode, Royal Flying Doctor), Silverton, Mutawintji National Park, Kinchega National Park, Menindee Lakes, Mungo National Park (Walls of China), White Cliffs, Lightning Ridge (opal, Car Door Tour), Bourke, Cobar, Brewarrina fish traps, Tibooburra, Sturt National Park, Cameron Corner, Wilcannia, Pooncarie, Willandra Lakes.
nsw-lord-howe-island: Lord Howe Island (NSW, World Heritage): Mount Gower, Ned's Beach, Lagoon, Malabar, Blinky Beach, Old Gulch, Kim's Lookout, Balls Pyramid (offshore), North Bay, Neds Beach feeding fish, Clear Place, museum, walks.
